findings: CVE-2026-40989 / GHSA-x9c7-5h6g-hq8q is a real published uncontrolled-recursion DoS in Spring Cloud Function routing: catalog lookup of a definition that composes functionRouter with itself bypasses the target-identity self-route guard and re-enters RoutingFunction until OOM.

Atomic BIC is 4d9cdb9750ceba2bfc634b03b77dc82494742269 (parent abeb6528305f3c5186cbd34583cf129f6b50410a), which first added and auto-registered RoutingFunction without cycle validation into a catalog that already supported '|' composition.

2023 commit e3a44c3cf30d3719d95c0225e7c72e6ca731ae3d is incomplete remediation (getTarget identity only). Direct OSS fix is 6bcd55803c5a2ce0adec794fee1e03c2fac36cf9 on 4.3.x (in v4.3.3, not v4.3.2); 5.0.x sibling is 57b4a1c05a48bb4240026e33bc05f2395ed5576c (in v5.0.2, not v5.0.1).
BIC authorship is human Oleg Zhurakousky with no AI/bot/generator marker on the commit object; verdict NOT_AI stands.
